verdict.rationale: The evidence only glances at this story. Honeycomb docs reference a 'retention period' for data, with SLO values tracked beyond it (honeycomb-docs-22). The API can 'programmatically manage datasets' (honeycomb-docs-11, honeycomb-docs-27), which implies, but does not show, the ability to delete datasets. Missing for 10: any documentation that users can configure retention duration, explicit data/dataset deletion controls, deletion request or erasure workflows, and independent corroboration.
